title: Ridgeline density comparison
intent: Compare the distribution of real Simpsons episode IMDb ratings across three seasons in compact vertically offset layers.

ai.create: Create a three-season ridgeline chart by binning the Simpsons dataset's imdb_rating field, using explicit baselines, grouped range areas, matching top lines, and a granular D3 basis curve.
ai.maintain: Change the selected seasons while keeping observed rating bins, offsets, scale domains, labels, identity, colors, and responsive curve geometry aligned.
